description: One call joins public SEC EDGAR data into an agent-ready brief: company profile, annual financial series (revenue, net income, assets, cash, EPS) with YoY growth and margins, recent filings, and risk-factor excerpts. Saves an agent five separate lookups and all the parsing. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: POST https://api.firstmention.uk/s/composite/filings

q.description: Ticker, company name or CIK, e.g. AAPL, nvidia, 320193

name: composite__filings
